title: silene patula subsp. amurensis
intro: Silene patula subsp. amurensis, commonly known as a plant species in the Caryophyllaceae family, is a type of flowering plant native to East Asia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Silene patula subsp. amurensis include reducing inflammation and fever, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
